description: 5e Spells compatibility test. P0 — top spell mod, tests Stats+StaticData functor chain.
assertions: assert((function() for _,u in ipairs(Ext.Mod.GetLoadOrder()) do local m=Ext.Mod.GetMod(u); if m and m.Info and string.find(string.lower(m.Info.Name or ''), '5e spells', 1, true) then return true end end return false end)(), '5e Spells present in load order')
assert((function() local entries=Ext.StaticData.GetAll('Feat'); return type(entries) == 'table' and #entries > 0 end)(), 'vanilla feat static data resolves')
assert((function() local id=Ext.Events.Tick:Subscribe(function() end); local ok=type(id) == 'number'; Ext.Events.Tick:Unsubscribe(id); return ok end)(), 'Tick event subscribe roundtrip executes')
notes: 5e Spells adds unimplemented D&D spells. Tests stat creation and functor resolution.
